preconditions.expression: N > 1 and all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 3 for edge in edgeList) and all(0 <= edge[0] < edge[1] < N for edge in edgeList) and all(edge[2] > 0 for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: N is an integer greater than 1, edgeList is a non-empty list of edges where each edge is a list of three integers [start, end, weight] with 0 ≤ start < end < N and weight > 0. The graph is a DAG (implied by start < end for all edges).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(any(edge[0] == u and edge[1] == v for edge in edgeList) or u == v for u in range(N) for v in range(N)))
postconditions.description: If there exists a path from vertex 0 to vertex N-1, return_value is the minimum total weight of such a path (sum of edge weights along the path). Otherwise, return_value is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= edge[0] < N and 0 <= edge[1] < N for edge in edgeList) and all(edge[2] > 0 for edge in edgeList)
postconditions.description: The edgeList remains structurally valid (vertices and weights unchanged) and the returned value is either a non-negative integer (valid path weight) or -1 (no path exists).
